wrong-owner-name.title: BIMI record is at the wrong owner name "{{name}}"
wrong-owner-name.detail: BIMI records must be published at <selector>._bimi.<domain>.

missing-selector.title: Missing selector
missing-selector.detail: BIMI records must be published as <selector>._bimi.<domain>. Use "default" unless you publish multiple logos.

invalid-selector.title: Invalid selector "{{selector}}"
invalid-selector.detail: Selectors must contain only letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.

invalid-version.title: Unsupported BIMI version "{{version}}"
invalid-version.detail: Only "BIMI1" is defined by the current draft.

missing-location.title: Missing logo URL (l=)
missing-location.detail: BIMI requires a logo URL pointing to an SVG Tiny PS file.

location-not-https.title: Logo URL is not HTTPS
location-not-https.detail: Mail clients only fetch BIMI logos over HTTPS.

location-not-svg.title: Logo URL does not end in .svg
location-not-svg.detail: BIMI requires SVG Tiny Portable/Secure logos. The URL should reference a .svg file.

authority-not-https.title: VMC URL is not HTTPS
authority-not-https.detail: The Verified Mark Certificate URL must use HTTPS.

authority-not-pem.title: VMC URL does not end in .pem
authority-not-pem.detail: The Verified Mark Certificate is usually published as a PEM file.

evidence-not-https.title: Evidence URL is not HTTPS
evidence-not-https.detail: The evidence document URL should use HTTPS.

missing-vmc.title: No Verified Mark Certificate (a=)
missing-vmc.detail: Gmail and Yahoo require a VMC to display the BIMI logo.

declination.title: Declination to participate in BIMI
declination.detail: This record explicitly tells receivers that the domain has chosen not to participate in BIMI.

no-dmarc.title: No DMARC record published
no-dmarc.detail: BIMI requires a DMARC record with an enforcing policy (quarantine or reject).

weak-dmarc-policy.title: DMARC policy is too weak for BIMI
weak-dmarc-policy.detail: Mail clients only honour BIMI when DMARC is set to quarantine or reject.

BIMI.name: BIMI
BIMI.description: Brand Indicators for Message Identification, display brand logos in supporting mail clients.
